limitations: The canonical scientific kit was not received/materialized; notes are staging only.
Searches were bounded public-source discovery, not comprehensive absence testing.
One EPSU page returned 403 Forbidden; no bypass or workaround was attempted.
Comoros exact retrieval times after the initial 03:08:34 UTC clock sample are approximate; see unit notes.

Danish demonstration.dk entry was available in search snippet but its opened page returned an empty/internal error; candidate is an announced recurring low-scale event without post-event confirmation.
DW Portuguese robots.txt blocked in Guinea-Bissau; two Hungarian police detail pages opened only to site-maintenance content.
Kenya: direct Nation Africa article access returned 403 Forbidden; search-result information and accessible corroboration were used, with no bypass.
Laos: RSF describes a severe media-control information environment; lack of results is especially weak evidence of absence.
Liberia: liberianobserver.com was blocked by robots.txt in search-provider results; no bypass attempted.
Search timestamp ranges for Kenya, Laos, Liberia, and Macedonia are approximate (about 03:11–03:14 UTC on 2026-10-11); exact clock samples were not taken per query.

Moldova: U.S. Embassy Chisinau demonstration alert page returned 403 Forbidden; OSAC item returned 405 Method Not Allowed; searches yielded scheduled-event information only, without post-event corroboration.

Netherlands: search provider blocked ad.nl, nu.nl, omroepwest.nl and rtvnoord.nl under robots.txt; no bypass attempted. Amsterdam Oct 7 crowd size unspecified; Delft Oct 6 turnout was estimated at about 50 and inclusion threshold pending.
Mali, Moldova, Mozambique, and Netherlands search timestamp ranges are approximate (about 03:14–03:16 UTC on 2026-10-11); exact clock samples were not taken per query.
North Korea: indexed-source discovery was especially weak; state-controlled information and limited independent reporting make negative search output particularly inconclusive.
Philippines: Rappler outlet search returned robots.txt block; no bypass attempted; Oct 7 event attendance size not identified.
Panama and Romania search timestamp ranges are approximate (about 03:16–03:18 UTC on 2026-10-11); exact per-query clock samples were not taken.
The literal scope audit identified Ghana missing from the inherited covered array; Ghana research was added to the researcher staging root before advancing.
Slovak Republic: Facebook event/post pages returned online-fetch throttling; the calendar listing and search snippets are advance/event-listing evidence, not verified attendance or occurrence.
South Korea: Naver and Yonhap Korean domains were blocked by robots.txt in search results; accessible Yonhap English/AFP reporting was used; turnout estimate is by the party.

Sudan: direct Facebook post fetch was throttled; no workaround attempted. Darfur conflict and access constraints make independent reporting sparse; Nyala Oct 1/2 date is inconsistent across source datelines/body.
Senegal, Slovak Republic, South Korea and Sudan retrieval time ranges were sampled approximately 03:18-03:21 UTC on 2026-10-11; per-query clock samples were not taken.

Switzerland: U.S. Embassy Bern alert page returned 403 Forbidden; no bypass attempted. Oct 7 Greenpeace petition handover is verified by organizer but whether this non-rally civic action falls within inclusion rules is unresolved; an Oct 6 memorial ceremony is not described as dissent.

Tanzania: Oct 4 Serengeti CHADEMA public-meeting lead appears in party-linked social account snippets; independent confirmation, size, and mass-mobilization inclusion are unresolved. Political restrictions/media environment limit negative inference.
Tunisia: available dated court coverage Oct 1–6 is about proceedings after a Sep 19 protest, not new in-window demonstrations; search snippets include out-of-window and 2024 anniversary actions.

Ukraine: Oct 6 Kyiv Oleshky rally corroborated by visual-agency records and UA.NEWS, but attendance is unreported; Oct 3 planned anti-government rally claims were assessed by domestic outlets as likely disinformation with no post-event confirmation.

Uzbekistan: no event found in bounded English/Russian/Uzbek Latin/Cyrillic searches. Constrained assembly space and limited independent media make negative search evidence weak; the visible Gazeta.uz politics-page excerpt is not a comprehensive event record.

Zambia: News Diggers dates the Lusaka vendor protest to Sep 29 (outside interval); October 3 coverage describes municipal/police clearance. Undated Facebook video/post snippets cannot establish an event date, and direct Facebook fetches were throttled; no bypass attempted.
